guarantees.claim: When sel_chk matches any of MUX4_SEL_0, MUX4_SEL_1, MUX4_SEL_2, or MUX4_SEL_3, err_o is driven to 1'b0.
guarantees.cond: sel_chk equals one of the enumerated MUX4_SEL values

guarantees.claim: When sel_chk does not match any of the four enumerated legal values (any other encoding, including X or Z), err_o is driven to 1'b1.
guarantees.cond: sel_chk is not one of MUX4_SEL_0..3

uncertain_points.claim: err_o may glitch during sel_chk transitions because combinational decoding may temporarily pass through illegal intermediate encodings.
uncertain_points.cond: sel_chk changes from one legal value to another and briefly takes a non-enumerated value
uncertain_points.risk: Spurious error assertion could trigger fault handling if not filtered or synchronized downstream.

uncertain_points.claim: The enumeration constants MUX4_SEL_0.._3 are defined outside this chunk; if they are not mutually exclusive or overlap, the unique case synthesizes unpredictably and err_o may not correctly indicate illegal states.
uncertain_points.risk: Illegal select values may be reported as legal (false negative) or constant error (false positive), breaking the safety check.

uncertain_points.claim: If sel_chk is X during reset or before being driven to a valid value, err_o will be asserted as 1 immediately, potentially causing a false fault before the system is ready.
uncertain_points.cond: Power-up, reset, or uninitialized state when sel_chk is X
uncertain_points.risk: Unintended fault response during initialization could corrupt security state or mask a real subsequent error.
